title: A new number creates its own Part Library entry, with no message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses in any upper and lower case or punctuation.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a description for part A in the Description field.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  4. Pick any category in the Category field.
  5. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  9. Click the part A row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.
  • No message about the Part Library appears.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • Exactly one entry is listed, with part A's part number and description.

Step 9:

  • The entry's detail page lists part A at the test location only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S7-R7: “If no entry matches, the system creates a Part Library entry with the typed number and description, and links the part to it.”
  • S7-R10: “No message about the Part Library is shown when the descriptions match, or when a new entry is created.”
  • S11-R6: “A new Part Library entry is created only from a part number in use: creating an inventory part (S7-R7 and S7-R8), a part request when the requested part is received, a delivery receipt, a core charge, returning a special-order part to inventory, returning a core to inventory, the parts CSV import, and the public API.”
